content.text: Patients w/ binge eating disorder suffer
over their binge eating, but they do
try to control their weight w/ compensatory behaviors,
not as fixated on shape & weight
psychotherapy + strict diet & exercise program from registered dietician
: inhibits pancreatic lipase which ⇣ fat absorbed
New addition to DSM-V that replaces/extends DSM-IV feeding disorder of infancy or early childhood
individual does not consume enough to grow/develop
sensory characteristics of food, concern over aversive consequences
➁ Not better explained by lack of food or cultural practice
: dieticians, gastroenterologists, MDs, mental health clinicians, occupational therapists, speech-language pathologists
(specialized form of CBT for ARFID), family-based therapy
: not usually first-line, no FDA-approved drugs for ARFID
: ⇣ cognitive rigidity affecting food beliefs, promotes wt gain
regurgitation of food after most meals (usually within 10min), often
▪︎not d/t GI or medical condition or another eating disorder
May be a clinical manifestation of
EATING OF NON-NUTRITIVE, NON-FOOD SUBSTANCES FOR ≥1MO
